PM_FAQ.a: Performance marketing is paid media bought and managed against a result the business cares about, then answered for. For D2C brands that result is contribution margin, the profit left after variable costs, not the ROAS a platform reports.

PM_FAQ.q: How does performance marketing work with MMC?
PM_FAQ.a: We audit your accounts and unit economics, set the structure and budgets against your break-even ROAS, run creative as a testing programme, and review weekly. One senior team handles Meta, Google, Amazon and quick commerce as one account, so you see the thinking, not just a report. Break-even ROAS is revenue per order divided by contribution per order; you can work yours out with the free break-even ROAS calculator.

Your ad spend is paid to the platforms and sits outside our fee. We quote our fee after a call, once we have seen your accounts and agreed what we will run. We do not publish a price list, because the right scope depends on your spend, your margins and how many channels you want run. Terms, including any minimum commitment, are agreed on the call.

D2C brands that sell direct online and want ad spend judged on profit: founders and growth heads whose ROAS has dropped, whose CAC keeps rising or whose creative has tired. Not only D2C. We work with D2C, B2B and education brands, and set the work up differently for each: D2C on contribution margin and repeat purchase, B2B on the cost of a qualified lead, education on enquiries, visits and admissions. See the B2B and education pages.

PM_FAQ.q: What do you need from us?
PM_FAQ.a: Access to your ad accounts, your store or CRM data, your product margins or the value of a qualified lead, and a named person who can approve creative.
